description: Test file for SQL store utilities in Mattermost, including functions for mapping strings to query parameters, sanitizing search terms, removing non-alphanumeric terms, and scanning SQL rows into a map.

methods.name: TestMapStringsToQueryParams
methods.description: Tests the MapStringsToQueryParams function for correct query parameter mapping with single and multiple items.

methods.name: BenchmarkMapStringsToQueryParams
methods.description: Benchmarks the MapStringsToQueryParams function for performance with single and multiple items.

methods.name: TestSanitizeSearchTerm
methods.description: Tests the sanitizeSearchTerm function for correct escaping of special characters.

methods.name: TestRemoveNonAlphaNumericUnquotedTerms
methods.description: Tests removal of non-alphanumeric and unquoted terms, including handling of Japanese and Chinese characters.

methods.name: TestScanRowsIntoMap
methods.description: Tests scanning SQL rows into a map with various scenarios including defaults and empty result sets.
